paper_title: COVTrack: Continuous Open-Vocabulary Tracking via Adaptive Multi-Cue Fusion
official_binding: Accepted CVF PDF page1 explicitly links zekunqian/COVTrack. Exact weights/run/config-paper numerical reproduction not verified; current main includes later release/QA changes.
license: Apache2.0 root LICENSE fully read; no imported code/assets.
paper_read_scope: Main PDF intro/task/dataset3/method4.1-4.6/experiments5.1-5.4/conclusion6 text. Not all diagrams visually or references/supplement/++extension.
original_task: Instance-level open-vocabulary MOT with supplied Base and Novel class vocabulary, not autonomous persistent unknown-category discovery.
model_inputs: Current image, frozen FasterRCNN/ResNet50 proposals, 1203 precomputed LVIS text embeddings and validation category-ID/Novel-role subset; previous per-video track memory. Training image pairs and GT boxes/match-index/labels use C-TAO annotation path unopened here.
model_outputs: Per-frame class-scored boxes,256D appearance embedding,512D mean normalized text/image RoI projections and per-video physical track IDs.
losses: GT positive proposal-pair association: unbiased multi-positive CE weight0.25 plus hard-negative mined cosine L2 weight1, on original appearance and fused representations after iteration1000. Explicit cycle-MSE disabled by active config/run. Cycle-softmax diagonals are computed for fusion but detached before fusion in actual Train path.
training_protocol: Config SGD0.002/momentum0.9/wd0.0001, samples12perGPU,4GPUs run_later, class-balanced base.json-path dataset and original-frame+extra8x sampling, uniformreference +/-30frames. Config10epochs; runner override20epochs. No command executed/no raw annotation opened.
online_or_offline: Offline paired-frame supervised tracker Train; image-plus-past physical-instance association at inference; full-track majority-vote category rewrite during default result formatting.
causal_or_noncausal: Inference association inspected uses current RoI+past memo, but formatter rewrites every category in a completed physical track using future predictions. This is not a causal category ledger. Training +/-30pairs is offline supervision, not itself inference future leakage.
state_memory: Per-video tracker reset at frame0, numeric instance IDs, EMA embed update, lastbox/lastclass and TTL10config/50runner. No crossvideo anonymous category bank, WAIT, rollback or versioned category events.
evaluation: Actual dataset evaluator formats all tracks with tcc=true, computes TETA using GT only externally; optional TAOTrackAP/LVISdetAP. run_later evaluates epoch checkpoint directory and writes Base/Novel results; no evaluated-best auto-selection demonstrated in inspected directory path and none used here.
contract_rejections: Output anonymization cannot remove upstream dependency: precomputed class text embedding, validation category mask, Novel-role-conditioned image/text geometric blend and vocabulary-size dynamicthreshold all affect detection/NMS before labels are removed.
Native class_name.py import references global vocabulary and split lists; file contents/class names/data were not read. No new vocabulary created or enabled.

GT visualization defaultvis=true conditionally opens a host-specific annotation pickle inside tracker construction; match accesses GT to choose logging indices and writes GT-containing diagnostics. Inspected fusion indices select observer returns, not actual fusedfeature rows. This still violates external-observer boundary; no actual GTmutation certificate.

Whole-track majority vote defaulttcc=true uses future predicted classes to rewrite historical outputs. Disabling this would define a different qualified frontend rather than reproduce native postprocessing.

Training class list includes all LVIS categories; base-only annotation filename alone proves no effective supervision legality. Actual source filters by configured catIDs, not explicit Knownfrequency. C-TAO effective labels/checkpoint training lineage not audited here.
static_source_paper_differences_not_exec: Paper fusion Eq5 confidence-weighted convex blend; source uses residual appearance + maxratio*(1-assoc_conf)^2*MLP, auxiliary gates additionally times0.5. Do not silently replace source and assert paper replication.
Paper location cue normalized by frame dimensions; active fusion feeds raw sampled or returned bbox coordinates intoLinear4to256. normalize_detections helper elsewhere not on inspected path.

Paper says end-to-end trainable interconfidence; actual Train cycle diagonals detached before fusion, with explicit cycle-MSE disabled. Gate/residual/appearance losses exist, but no interconfidence gradient claim.
Paper10epochs/threshold0.35/memo30 versus config10/.5/10/max50 and runner20/.37/50/max80/momentum0.4. Keep all three configurations separate.
Projection and projection_for_image belong toRoI head outside frozen bboxhead list; freeze_detector flag does not itself prove all detector-derived semantic projections frozen.

RoI classifier already softmax-normalizes text/image scores and geometrically blends them, then bboxhead get_bboxes applies softmax again. These are category scores, not a certified foreground-probability calibration.
Uncertainty simple_test exception tries host-specific torch.save then sys.exit(0); native exitstatus alone not a cache success marker. This source path not executed.
simple_test builds filename slice at literalval substring even on other scoped inputs; portability/staticqualification only, no observed failure.

CocoVideoDataset np.int legacy source incompatible with unmodified modernNumPy alias removal; full legacyMMCV/mmdet/clip stack/requirements not installed or run. ExistingMASA smoke environment is not automatically COVTrack-ready.
paper_limitations_summary: Paper reports OVMOT supplied-vocabulary instance association, dense-pair benefits and diminishing returns of full annotation. No anonymous crossvideo category lifecycle, selfcorrection/versioned rollback or our metric acceptance demonstrated.
TrackOCD_root_connection: Confidence-aware visual/geometry fusion is a bounded cue reliability hypothesis. Physical-instance memo and fulltrack category voting cannot serve as persistent category identity. Valid recovered shards remain evidence/assets, not certified lawful frontend by this review.
what_to_borrow: After lawful independent Train qualification, explicit current/past cue reliabilities and Raw-versus-fusion controls, using anonymous visual/location-only inputs.
what_not_to_borrow: Novel text/split masks/dynamic vocabulary thresholds, in-forward GTvisualization, wholetrack retrospective class rewriting or supplied semantic classification as discovery.
requires_before_qualified_import: Actual future/ID/GT mutation checks including formatter
